plan.failureSummary: Cached Page.AI replay failed trying to locate 'Last Name *' field because the current survey form renders different fields ('Your Name *', 'Contact Email *', 'Occupation *').
observedIndicators: Execution failed in deterministic replay at .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js:38:9.
Failure screenshot shows the form contains 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' instead of 'Last Name *' / data-testid='input-lastname'.
The test's high-level semantic intent ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...') is flexible and adaptable to varying form fields.
isRetryAttempt is false and deterministic replay mode was active.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and trigger an automated retry so that Page.AI generates new actions for the live form structure.

remediationSteps.summary: Review caching strategy for dynamic survey forms
remediationSteps.details: If the survey randomly changes fields on each run, consider configuring dynamic handling or verifying whether deterministic caching should be disabled for this spec.

additionalDataRequests.description: Check if the survey app dynamically changes form fields across sessions.
suggestedSources: Application source code or survey configuration

plan.notes: The survey structure has changed or varies dynamically. The failure occurred entirely inside the generated cache replay file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) attempting to fill 'Last Name *', which does not exist in the current DOM. Regenerating the cache with a fresh autonomous run will allow Page.AI to adapt to the current form fields.
